headlines.title: Strategy to Leave MSCI Indexes By Month End, Metaplanet Also Out
headlines.summary: Strategy and Metaplanet, both flagged by MSCI’s non-operating company screen, drop out of its indexes at the Nov. 30 close, and Strategy is the only one of 24 USA Index deletions not moving down to small cap.

headlines.title: MSCI Drops Michael Saylor’s Strategy (MSTR): Is Bitcoin Price at Risk?
headlines.summary: Nvidia investors have Jensen Huang. Bitcoin investors have nobody, and that may be the biggest difference between the two assets. But here’s the catch: Wall Street has poured billions into Bitcoin ETF products, which were originally designed to operate without a corporate leader.

headlines.title: Strategy to be removed from MSCI indexes: What are the risks for Bitcoin?
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- MSCI confirmed on Nov 11 that Strategy Inc (MSTR) will be dropped from its global indexes, effective Dec 1. Removal doesn’t touch Strategy’s Bitcoin holdings directly. The danger is the financing chain behind them.

headlines.title: Bitcoin edges lower to $73.5k; Strategy drops on MSCI index removal
headlines.summary: Investing.com-- Bitcoin slid on Thursday as sentiment towards cryptocurrencies remained quashed by risks from higher U.S. interest rates and a less favorable regulatory outlook.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
